## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# NetZapret

**For those who need more than one Zapret.** Desync fixes what the provider slows down, VPN handles what is blocked by country, and NetZapret decides where each traffic goes, for each site and service.

### [⬇ Download the latest version](https://github.com/RixyPow/netzapret/releases/latest)

Archive for Windows 10 and 11: unpack and run `NetZapret.exe`, nothing else needs to be installed.

Traffic dispatcher for Windows. For each service, domain or subnet it decides where traffic goes: **through desync** (Zapret / winws2), **through VPN** (sing-box) or **directly**, and launches the engines under one supervision.

It replaces the Zapret + VPN client combination and does what none of them does separately: **applies VPN selectively, without breaking desync for everything else.**

A VPN subscription is not required. Without it, desync, free WARP and a proxy for Telegram Desktop work: Telegram with photos and videos without any VPN.

## About the program

Author: [RixyPow](https://github.com/RixyPow). Ideas and bug reports come from participants in the [discussions](https://github.com/RixyPow/netzapret/discussions) and [issues](https://github.com/RixyPow/netzapret/issues) — post new ones there too.

> Pine is currently an early developer preview and is not suitable for daily work or important data. The UI, data formats, Agent behavior, and project structure may all undergo incompatible changes; no stable release, migration, or compatibility guarantees are provided.

## Background

Most AI Agent tools are aimed at developers: terminals, editor plugins, and command-line arguments. People who handle documents, spreadsheets, reports, and materials every day can mostly only reach their own files indirectly through a web chat box.

Pine aims to provide a desktop Agent harness for this kind of scenario:

- Common office file formats (text, images, video, PDF, DOCX, XLS/XLSX, PPTX) can be previewed directly within the workspace. The Agent operates on the files you see.
- The Agent's reads, reasoning, tool calls, and file modifications are all shown in the session log. Operations that require approval ask first, and a run can be aborted at any time.
- Projects, sessions, and files are stored on your local machine. Model connections (API key / OAuth) are configured by you; Pine does not act as a relay.
- Open-sourced under AGPL-3.0.

chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotions aside, watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of odds movements across three channels. No bets on low odds, no entry when signals are unclear. Execution is automatic before kickoff, and settlement is automatic after the result.

## 🚀 Live Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Updated automatically every hour, historical dates archived and available to review anytime
- Covers **500–1300+** matches per day (Jingcai / Asian handicap, full coverage), with signals and bets automatically flagged

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: piled up a roomful of parameters, only to look back and realize the model was just reciting prices the market had already set. No matter how many parameters, it couldn't produce anything new.

We tried **studying market manipulation**: guessing at the bookmakers' moves, and the more we guessed, the more it looked like paranoia. In the end we figured out that guessing the house is worse than reading the price.

We also tried **AI predictions**: injuries, motivation, form. Each one sounded perfectly reasonable, and each one had already been priced into the odds. However lively the story, the line doesn't care.

Having gone down all those detours, one plain truth remains:

> **Follow where the money goes; the line tells the story.**
> But people reading the lines tend to get carried away: chasing favorites, fearing underdogs, getting shaky at the last minute. It's obvious at a glance when emotion is doing the trading.

So we hand both the 'watching' and the 'buying' to machines, and keep just one thing for people: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 odds** watch market-wide odds movements: which side has been collectively abandoned, which is quietly being defended, and whether the draw line has been given up. This is the closest informant.

**Asian handicap** watches the line and water levels: sudden last-minute pivots and sniping by sharp money on the favored side. Money thrown in with real cash is more trustworthy than anything said out loud.

**Over/Under** watches the total line. When a goal-scoring hotbed appears, the match's goal count is often already predictable.

The three informants each bring their own news. Only when the news lines up does the referee dare to make a call. **Matches where they don't line up (1X2 and Asian handicap contradict each other) are skipped entirely.** If the informants are already arguing among themselves, why bet at all?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything else is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds**: single-selection odds below 1.5, or double-selection odds below 1.3 after adjustment, are never bought regardless of how good the signal looks. At odds that low, even a win doesn't make real money.
- **No entry when signals are unclear**: no signal, conflicting signals, or a vague direction all mean sitting out. Missing a bet doesn't lose money; a wrong bet does.
- **Quality determines stake size**: the stronger the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No going all-in.
- **Bets placed automatically 15 minutes before kickoff, results settled automatically when they come in**: no last-minute jitters, no urge to raise stakes after a win or chase losses after a defeat.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any betting advice. Lottery tickets should be purchased at official physical retail outlets. Participation is not permitted for anyone under 18 years old.

cuzic/awase.description: A simultaneous-keystroke keyboard remapper for NICOLA thumb shift and beyond
cuzic/awase.body:
# awase — Thumb-shift (NICOLA) keyboard remapper

*[English](https://github.com/cuzic/awase/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)*

**awase** (合わせ) is a keyboard remapper that enables thumb-shift input on Windows.

---

## What is thumb shift

Thumb shift (NICOLA layout) uses the "変換" (Henkan) and "無変換" (Muhenkan) keys on either side of the space bar as thumb-shift keys. Pressing them simultaneously with letter keys enters kana characters directly. It lets you type Japanese with fewer keystrokes than romaji input, and once learned, enables fast and efficient typing.

awase intercepts physical key input with a low-level keyboard hook, detects simultaneous keystrokes, and sends them to the IME as romaji. The IME performs kanji conversion as usual.

---

## Features

- **NICOLA-compliant simultaneous keystroke detection** — three-key arbitration via d1/d2 comparison
- **Two commit modes** — wait / ngram\_predictive
- **n-gram adaptive threshold** — dynamically adjusts the decision window using 2/3-grams derived from a Wikipedia corpus to improve accuracy
- **Yamabuki-compatible `.yab` layout files** — existing layout data can be used as-is
- **Broad app support** — automatically identifies Win32 / UWP / TSF native apps (Chrome, VS Code, WezTerm, etc.)
- **Multi-layer fault-tolerant design** — multiple safeguards: hook liveness monitoring, sleep-resume recovery, IME detection failure fallback, and automatic TSF cold-start recovery
- **Asynchronous architecture** — asynchronous executor based on the Windows message loop; blocking APIs are isolated on separate threads with timeout protection
- **Automatic focus detection** — conversion automatically stops outside text input fields
- **System tray resident** — layout switching, settings screen, and toggle between thumb-shift and romaji input
- **US layout support** — switch to the US physical layout with `keyboard_model = "us"`. Since there are no Muhenkan/Henkan keys, it also supports spoofing the left/right Alt keys as thumb keys and turning Space into a thumb key

For technical design details, see [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/cuzic/awase/blob/HEAD/ARCHITECTURE.md).

---

# LYStar Code

Hand tasks to the Agent, follow its execution, read files, and review changes on the same page. You can start from a piece of code, or configure agents with different responsibilities to work on a project together through a collaboration space and a task board.

## What you can do with it

| What you want to do | Capabilities the workspace provides |
| --- | --- |
| Understand a project, fix bugs, implement features | The Agent reads and edits files, searches code, runs shell commands, and presents the process and results in the conversation |
| Make requests while checking changes | The right-side review workspace provides file browsing, Git changes and history, run records, and session branches |
| Work on multiple projects at once | Manage sessions by project, with project grouping, search, and resuming past sessions |
| Divide work among multiple agents | Configure each agent's model, Skills, and tools, and organize work through a collaboration space, member messages, and a task board |
| Use your own model service | Configure Providers, API Keys, and custom models, and switch models and thinking intensity in the input area |
| View and continue from another device | The service runs on the computer where LYStar is installed, and a computer or phone browser connects to the WebUI |
| Stay compatible with the Pi ecosystem | Use compatible Skills, Extensions, Packages, Themes, Prompt Templates, and MCP tools |

## Installation

### macOS / Linux

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/lystar-team/lystar-code/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

The installer detects the system and architecture, verifies the SHA-256 checksum, and installs to `~/.local/share/lystar-agent/`. Both macOS and Linux provide x64 and ARM64 packages.

### Windows 10 / 11

Run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 or later:

```powershell
$cmd="$env:TEMP\lystar-install.cmd"; iwr -UseBasicParsing https://github.com/lystar-team/lystar-code/releases/latest/download/install.cmd -OutFile $cmd; & $cmd
```

metasequoiaime/msime-cloud.description: 水杉云: the shared Go backend for 水杉输入法, providing cloud candidates, AI association, translation, speech recognition, and Swagger API documentation
metasequoiaime/msime-cloud.body:
# 水杉云（msime-cloud）

水杉云 is the shared network backend for 水杉输入法, implemented in Go. The HTTP service is built on the standard library, and WebSocket uses a pinned version of [coder/websocket](https://github.com/coder/websocket). It centrally stores provider credentials and serves HTTP APIs and real-time speech WebSockets to Windows, macOS, iOS, and Linux. Platforms remain responsible for local input, focus, candidate merging, microphone permissions, and committing text to the document.

The current service and per-platform source integration are implemented. Network tests from a real client to a synthetic upstream have passed, and native host acceptance is still in progress. For the full requirements and open items, see [需求核对](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime-cloud/blob/HEAD/docs/requirements.md) (requirements review).

## Getting Started

Requires Go 1.26.10 or later. Docker builds and CI use the same minimum version, which includes the published standard library security fixes. CI checks for known Go vulnerabilities reachable from the project using `govulncheck`.

```sh
cp config.example.json config.json
export MSIME_CLIENT_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
go run ./cmd/msime-server -config config.json
```

Clients access the service with `Authorization: Bearer <MSIME_CLIENT_TOKEN>`. Each device is assigned its own random token and client ID. Add them to the `clients` array and inject them through different environment variables. Do not embed provider keys or shared public tokens in clients. After changing the config and tokens, restart the service.

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $MSIME_CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/capabilities
curl -G -H "Authorization: Bearer $MSIME_CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode 'text=nihao' http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cloud/candidates
```

`config.example.json` enables only cloud candidates. To configure other features, fill in the admin-controlled full HTTPS endpoint URL, the server-side model, and the environment variable referenced by `token_env`. An empty URL means the feature is disabled and returns 503. For external deployment, expose HTTPS through a TLS reverse proxy, and restrict public ports so that only the reverse proxy is reachable. Inside the container, change `listen` to `0.0.0.0:8080` and mount the config read-only at `/config/config.json`…

nameczz/overseas-saas-topic-radar.description: Overseas SaaS / AI / 小红书 / 公众号 topic radar, updated every 3 hours
nameczz/overseas-saas-topic-radar.body:
# Overseas SaaS Topic Radar

Overseas SaaS / AI tools / Mini Programs / 小红书 / 公众号 topic radar.

It collects product, technology, community, and trend signals from public sources, scores them on a composite of "viral potential, commercial value, content fit, timeliness, and actionability," and generates a real-time dashboard that can be deployed to Vercel.

## Sources

- AIHOT: `https://aihot.virxact.com/`
- Buzzing: `https://www.buzzing.cc/`
- Hacker News Algolia: keywords such as AI / SaaS / agent / indie hacker
- GitHub Search: recently fast-growing AI / SaaS / automation / agent repos
- Hugging Face Models: Trending models, Spaces, and AI capability signals
- Dev.to: articles related to AI / SaaS / startup / product
- Product Hunt RSS: new product signals (if the RSS feed is accessible)

## Running Locally

```bash
npm install
npm run refresh
npm run dev
```

Open <http://localhost:3000>.

## Update Frequency

`.github/workflows/update-radar.yml` runs every 3 hours:

1. Collect the latest signals
2. Re-score and generate `public/data/latest.json`
3. Commit and push if there are changes
4. Vercel automatically redeploys once it is connected to the repo

Manual runs are also supported:

```bash
npm run refresh
```

## Scoring Logic

Total score 0-100:

- Heat / signal strength: 25%
- Relevance to overseas SaaS / AI / agent / automation / Mini Program opportunities: 25%
- Fit for 公众号 / 小红书 content distribution: 20%
- Commercialization / productization opportunity: 20%
- Timeliness: 10%

The "Recommended Actions" on the dashboard map candidate topics to: 公众号 in-depth articles, 小红书 cards, SaaS / Mini Program opportunities, and resource library tracking.
